reason: IIS sends Server: Microsoft-IIS/10.0; webForCore's host is Kestrel.
An unmatched extensionless URL gets IIS's native 404 page (StaticFile handler); webForCore serves ASP.NET's 404 page. Same status.
IIS's native 404 page is not ASP.NET's, so it has no X-AspNet-Version.

Trace.Refresh() and Trace's own listeners: on .NET Framework, Trace.Listeners is <trace><listeners> again and autoflush and indentsize are configuration's; .NET resets them to its defaults after Trace.Refreshing, the last point where configuration can apply them (docs/NAMESPACES.md, WebApi.Gate.Tests' TraceRefreshLeavesTraceWithDotNetsDefaults, #213).
